title: Pick & Trade
description: Upgrade your trading experience! Features a custom parchment interface that lets you see all villager offers instantly and choose specific enchantment levels without the hassle.
body:
📜 Pick & Trade
Are you tired of clicking endlessly through the vanilla villager trading menu? Pick & Trade completely overhauls the trading experience by replacing the clunky default interface with a beautiful, custom parchment-style UI.

✨ Key Features
📜 RPG-Style Parchment Interface: Say goodbye to the boring standard menu! Immerse yourself with a beautifully designed, centered parchment UI that fits perfectly into the Minecraft world.

📚 Smart Enchantment Picker: No more cycling through endless Librarian trades! Instantly view all available enchantments on a single screen and easily choose your exact desired level (Level I to V) with just one click.

🤝 All Offers at a Glance: For all other villager professions, every available trade is displayed neatly on one organized screen. No more hidden trades or tedious scrolling!

⚙️ Fully Multi-Loader: Built to be accessible for everyone. Fully tested and supported on Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1.

🛠️ Installation
Simply download the correct version for your mod loader (Fabric, Forge, or NeoForge) and drop the .jar file into your mods folder.
